Lightbringer music credits

Battle music
"The Tread of War" Composed by Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/the-tread-of-war-rpg-orchestral-essentials-military-music
Imported from the user's download: The Tread of War MP3.zip
Asset: Assets/Audio/Resources/Music/TheTreadOfWar.mp3
Original audio bytes are unchanged; the game repeats the track and changes playback volume.
SHA256: 7230283EB7FD48F76981781B2EA47B2C44CDD52D470308AB98D57BFBA7F7B06E
The original bundled license and readme PDFs are preserved in Docs/ThirdParty/TheTreadOfWar/.
In-game attribution appears in the pause screen (Esc / P).

Prologue music (connected to the 18-scene illustrated prologue)

Source: https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/legionnaire-2022/

Imported unchanged from the user's download.

In-game attribution appears under '음악 정보' in the prologue; playback loops with volume fades.
For published videos using either track, also include the relevant music attribution in the description.

Both selected downloads are available under the attribution licenses above; no purchases were made.
